task_instance: Run a growth/marketing teardown of one SaaS company: execute Stage 1 'Build the Spine' free collectors (teardown.mjs site/stack/history/ads/detect) against the target's domain to produce the traffic curve (traffic.csv) and dated move log (moves.csv), then proceed through the funnel/hidden-signals/content stages to deliver teardowns/<target>/playbook.md with evidence-labeled findings and plays.
blocker_detail: Every stage of this skill's core deliverable is built from live public evidence that can only be gathered over the network: the bundled collector script fetches the target's robots.txt and sitemap, queries the public web-archive (Wayback) index for pixel/stack and pricing history, resolves DNS TXT/MX/CNAME records and certificate-transparency subdomain logs, and pulls ad-library and SEO-vendor estimates. The runtime is an air-gapped offline workstation with no network of any kind, so none of these fetches or DNS lookups can run and no observed evidence can be collected. The funnel, team-voices, and content stages likewise depend on fetching live pages, social posts, and transcripts. Several sources are also paid third-party vendors (named in the skill as DataForSEO/Semrush/Ahrefs/Similarweb and a ScrapeCreators API key) that need accounts and credentials. The only collector steps that touch only local files (the 'moves' correlation and 'diff') cannot be exercised because they consume traffic.csv/moves.csv, which are outputs the network collectors must first produce; fabricating those CSVs to run them would be fabricating collector output, which the run rules forbid. A separate aggravating issue: in this placeholder copy of the skill the collector's endpoint URLs are replaced by tokens like [url-5], so even its request targets are unavailable.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: the deliverable is an evidence-grounded growth teardown (traffic curve + dated moves + gap table + plays) whose Evidence Standard requires every finding be 'Observed' (a fetched page/row/ad that is linked) or 'Inferred', never guessed. Inspected scripts/teardown.mjs (1227 lines): grep shows network calls throughout - fetch() in the generic get() helper at line ~523, node:dns resolveTxt/resolveMx/resolveCname in the dns command (~665-670), Wayback/CDX fetch (~683), sc-ads fetch with x-api-key header (~771), and the command dispatcher routing site/stack/history/ads/detect/dns/subdomains/hero/sitemap-growth through these. The script's outbound URLs are placeholders ([url-5], [url-8], [url-13], etc.). An attempt to run `node teardown.mjs detect [host-1]` was additionally blocked by the harness's external-code classifier; regardless, the air-gapped runtime provides no network so the collectors cannot gather any public evidence.
